title: Payload models derived from FHIR logical models
description: Stakeholder directive, in the context of Stakeholder directive: open standards for types and schemas; DVCMin logical model (trust-phw); DVCMinVaccineDetails logical model (trust-phw); W3C JSON-LD 1.1; W3C Shapes Constraint Language (SHACL).

statements.label: Payload models derived from FHIR logical models
statements.requirement: Payload schemas SHALL be derived mechanically from the published FHIR logical models, not written by hand: a JSON-LD 1.1 context that maps the payload's short element names to IRIs, SHACL shapes for cardinality, primitive patterns, invariants and bindings, and CDDL for the CBOR encoding. Inputs SHALL be pinned to a source commit. Typed payload codecs SHALL be checked against these derived schemas.

successCriteria.criterion: Schema checks against the vectors (req:stt-tst-008) passes.

sources.quote: Minimal DVC payload for use within an HCERT Payload
